blocks.text: Mastering Excel for e-commerce merchandisers on mac

As a merchandiser, you live in spreadsheets. You track SKUs, pricing, and inventory levels across multiple channels. Doing this on a Mac requires knowing the specific quirks of the Microsoft 365 environment. You must balance speed with accuracy.

Common issues include formatting numbers as text and managing large datasets. If you find your spreadsheet slowing down, it might be time to clean up your formulas. Use simple calculations where possible to maintain performance.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for Mac users
Using these shortcuts saves significant time during your day. If a shortcut conflicts with a Mac system setting, check System Settings > Keyboard > Shortcuts to resolve the overlap.

Inventory management often involves importing CSV files from platforms like Shopify. These files often contain formatting errors. For example, Excel might strip leading zeros from your product IDs. Always set your ID columns to Text format before importing.
If you are unsure where a specific setting is, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur. It will draw a circle around the menu item you need.
blocks.title: Find tools fast

blocks.text: Use data validation to prevent entry errors. Go to Data > Data Tools > Data Validation to create drop-down lists for your categories. This ensures your data remains consistent across your team.

You likely manage several stores or platforms. Switching between them is a major source of fatigue. Keep your browser profiles organized. Use tools like SupaSidebar to manage different windows. When you work in Excel, keep your source data in a separate window to avoid confusion.

If you need to research a competitor's price while in Excel, hold the shortcut for Lazur. Ask it to look up the product and summarize the results. You can stay in your spreadsheet while Lazur handles the search in a background tab.

faq.question: Can I use Excel shortcuts on Mac easily?
faq.answer: Yes, but some conflict with macOS system shortcuts. You can adjust these in your Mac System Settings.

faq.question: How do I fix leading zeros in Excel?
faq.answer: Select the column, right-click, choose Format Cells, and select Text. This prevents Excel from removing the zeros.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me in Excel?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you through menus, but you perform the actual clicks.
